_comment: Client presentation only. No values affect shots, rewards, unlocks or prices.
_aimReportSeconds: How often the client streams its aim direction for crosshair-placement telemetry. Fast enough that a target's reveal lands within one sample of the truth on a drill whose targets live under a second, slow enough to be a rounding error next to the movement replication already going up the same wire.
_drillCueSeconds: How long Peek's bearing cue stays on screen. Shorter than range.cueLeadSeconds would leave the player without it at the moment it matters; much longer and it is still up when the target is already gone.
_scaling: Text sizes below are pixel counts at referenceViewportPixels tall. Roblox reports real device pixels, so 13px is comfortable at 900 tall, unreadable at 2160 and oversized on a phone. UiTheme.px() scales them by the viewport height against that reference, clamped by textScaleLimits so a large monitor grows the UI without turning it into a billboard.
_fonts: Every value in `fonts` is validated against Enum.Font by OverworldSpec, which iterates the whole table -- so notes live out here, not in it. `mono` is RobotoMono for the Shoothouse clock: a proportional face makes a ticking timer jitter sideways every time a digit changes width, which on a mode whose entire point is the clock is the one place that reads as broken.
